name: Pendle-PT (normal, steep)
recommendations: Steep normal curve: a slope of ~6.54%/yr and a ~6.00% term spread pay a real premium for locking longer. Locking the longer tenor is well compensated.
Reinvest-adjusted optimum: the ~365-day tenor (~11.00% APR) gives the best carry once a reinvestment-rate assumption is priced onto the short end (pickup vs short ~6.92%).
High term premium: the curve pays ~6.00% extra at the long end. Confirm the long-tenor source is durable before locking into it.
